verdict.rationale: AFK is a SaaS company-operations platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack never mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec. The integrations with Mercury, Gusto, Carta and Stripe are outbound tool connections, not a server that external agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
